study_identification_part.si4_title: Neuroanatomical heterogeneity and homogeneity in individuals at clinical high risk for psychosis

cm1_clarity_of_research_objectives.reason: The abstract explicitly states the aim to quantify neuroanatomical heterogeneity across multiple MRI measures comparing CHR-P with healthy controls and examining transition to psychosis, which clearly defines the research objective and application of normative modeling.
cm1_clarity_of_research_objectives.supporting_text: "We aimed to quantify the neuroanatomical heterogeneity in structural magnetic resonance imaging measures of cortical surface area (SA), cortical thickness (CT), subcortical volume (SV), and intracranial volume (ICV) in CHR-P individuals compared with healthy controls (HC), and in relation to subsequent transition to a first episode of psychosis."

nm1_clarity_of_inclusion_and_exclusion_c.reason: The study notes the HC sample size from 29 sites and points to prior work for detailed inclusion/exclusion while describing QC exclusions (>5% missing ROIs) and IRB removals, but it does not lay out specific eligibility criteria for healthy controls within this manuscript.
nm1_clarity_of_inclusion_and_exclusion_c.supporting_text: "The ENIGMA CHR-P dataset amalgamated clinical and neuroimaging data from 29 sites, comprising ... 1243 HC participants... Further participant inclusion and exclusion criteria have been previously described [20]... Participants with >5% missing ROIs were excluded from the current analyses as this was deemed to be indicative of poor parcellation (eFig. 1)."
nm1_clarity_of_inclusion_and_exclusion_c.location: Baldwin2022.pdf.md: Participants / MRI data acquisition and processing

nm5_details_of_data_preprocessing.reason: Preprocessing is described with FreeSurfer automated pipelines under the ENIGMA protocol, listing steps (motion correction, skull stripping, segmentation, normalization) and QC procedures (outlier detection, visual inspection, exclusion >5% missing ROIs).
nm5_details_of_data_preprocessing.supporting_text: "All neuroimaging data were processed according to FreeSurfer automated pipelines and the standardised ENIGMA protocol... includes motion correction, automated Talairach transformation, skull stripping, segmentation of the subcortical white matter and grey matter volumetric structures, and intensity normalisation. nm6_internal_data_validation_in_healthy_.reason: The study does not report any train/test splits or cross-validation on healthy controls; analyses used the full dataset for VR/CV and PBSI without internal data partitioning.

nm7_external_data_validation_in_healthy_.reason: No application of the normative or variability models to an independent external healthy-control dataset is described; all analyses rely on the single ENIGMA CHR-P/HC dataset.

nm8_details_of_normative_modeling_approa.reason: The manuscript details the statistical approaches: VR and log-CV calculations with formulas, PBSI computation using Spearman correlations within-group and normative references, z-scoring against HC norms, and thresholding at >1.5 SD, along with software (R 4.0.3, metafor/meta).
nm8_details_of_normative_modeling_approa.supporting_text:
"We conducted a supplementary calculation of the log Coefficient of Variation (log-CV) ratio index... calculated according to the formula below... sensitivity analyses... leave-one-out resampling... age-, sex-, and site-matched sample."
"Person-Based Similarity Index... concatenating the respective regional measures... Spearman correlation coefficients... Group-level comparisons... Normative reference... correlated with the corresponding profiles of the members of the HC group... transformed into z-scores... We set >1.5 SD as a threshold..."
"All analyses were conducted within R v.4.0.3; the VR analyses were conducted using the metafor and meta packages."

nm9_model_performance_and_calibration_on.reason: The study reports variability statistics and PBSI comparisons but does not provide quantitative fit or calibration metrics (e.g., R^2, coverage) assessing model performance on healthy controls.

nm10_demographics_and_characteristics_of.reason: No data partitions (train/test or folds) were created for healthy controls; only overall sample characteristics are given, so demographic details by partition are absent.
